# HexPiece 3.9.8

The Itsumade's kit, part 3 (from your spec): four of its moves as a human. **Not tested in game yet:** the build and every test suite
pass, and every new pose (each clip from three sides), the fire, the Haki rings, the clouds and the lightning were rendered and
checked off-game.

## As a human
- **X Gorosei Stare**: fix your sight on a foe (up to 48 blocks, in plain sight) and glare. The air round it is drawn in tight (a dark
  ring closing on it, black wisps pulled in) while your clenched fist shakes. A moment later it is thrown far back and knocked down, and
  a shockwave of your Haki's light bursts off it the way it flies. No foe in sight: nothing happens, nothing is spent.
- **C Enormous Presence**: for 10 seconds your body lets out the Conqueror's Haki on its own. It crackles with short arcs of its
  lightning and a dark haze rises off it. Every 2 seconds a wave of it sweeps out over the ground and presses down whoever is near (12
  blocks). Every half second or so a bolt leaps out of your body (shoulders, hands, chest: whichever is nearest) onto a foe within 10
  blocks, hurting and stunning it.
- **V Yokai Blast** (hold): point your hand (the other bracing it). A ball of fire gathers in it, white-hot through an orange skin, black
  flames licking round it. Let go and a beam of bright orange fire with black flames twisting round it pours out of your hand where you
  pointed (it cannot be turned after), for 1 to 5 seconds by the charge. It bores through 5 to 15 blocks of ground by the charge
  (nothing dropped, all of it grows back after 30 seconds) and burns what it touches.
- **B Thy Death**: raise your hand to the sky. Black storm clouds roll in over you (34 blocks up), and for 10 seconds the Conqueror's
  lightning falls out of them all round you (25 blocks). Every bolt lands on the ground (or water, never the air) and bursts in a ball
  of your Haki's light 3 blocks across, hurting and stunning what it catches.

With Ryou on, Gorosei Stare and the Yokai Blast throw the Conqueror's lightning too (the house rule for every fruit). Every move has its
first-person hand move.

## The Yokai fire looks better
The Yokai Beam in its form (3.9.7) shares the new fire: before, its black flames sheathed the whole beam and the ball in the jaws, so
both read as black smoke with no orange showing. Now the black flames twist round the fire in tongues, and the bright orange fire and
its white-hot heart show between them.
